collections.title: BMW M Neue Klasse Wheels & Future Upgrades
collections.description:
Pre-launch fitment status: BMW M has confirmed that its new generation of fully electric high-performance models will use Neue Klasse technology from 2027. The final production model name, complete specifications and vehicle-specific wheel fitment have not yet been officially confirmed.

Made-to-order wheels for the BMW M Neue Klasse

The forged wheel designs shown below are made to order. Once the production vehicle’s technical data becomes available, selected designs can be engineered specifically for the BMW M Neue Klasse — commonly associated with the expected “ZA0” designation.

Final wheel diameters, widths, offsets, load requirements, brake clearance and tyre specifications will be determined after official vehicle data or a physical fitment assessment is available. Displaying a wheel design on this page therefore does not mean that its vehicle-specific configuration has already been validated.

Our future wheel programme will focus on lightweight forged construction, correct load capacity, brake clearance, aerodynamic efficiency and an OEM+ fitment. Explore our BC Forged wheels and Brixton Forged wheels to compare the available made-to-order designs.

Suspension, lowering, brake and aerodynamic products will only be added once the production chassis and relevant technical requirements have been confirmed.

Interested in a future setup? Contact BaanVelgen and we will keep your preferred design in mind as soon as verified fitment development can begin.
